title: Vendor risk-tiering pilot and SOC2‑Lite onboarding bundle with insurance mapping
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: run a 6-week pilot to validate a tiered vendor onboarding flow that bundles a lightweight ‘SOC2‑Lite’ evidence package, a mapped insurance requirement matrix, and a simplified vendor portal flow for small-to-mid enterprises. Hypotheses: 1) Packaging a SOC2‑Lite artifact + clear insurance checkbox will reduce enterprise procurement back-and-forth by >=30% and shorten deal cycle by 10–15%. 2) Offering a priced onboarding tier (no contract negotiation for low-risk tiers) will increase conversion from trial to paid by 8–12% among self-serve accounts requiring basic compliance. Scope: 1) Define three vendor risk tiers (Low/Medium/High) and corresponding onboarding artifacts (SOC2‑Lite summary, standard ATO checklist, recommended insurance limits). 2) Build a vendor-portal micro-flow (UI + API) that surfaces required artifacts and allows customers to acknowledge/accept templates. 3) Create one pricing experiment (tiered onboarding fee or included for committed seats) and measurement plan. Out of scope for pilot: full SOC2 certification support, custom contract negotiation integrations, and enterprise legal review automation. Success metrics: reduction in average procurement back-and-forth messages (measured in Zendesk/Gmail threads) by >=30% within pilot cohort; decrease in average days-to-first-paid by >=10%; NPS of procurement experience >=7 from trial participants; conversion delta tracked per cohort. Acceptance criteria: - Backend API that returns tier and required artifacts for an account - Portal screen that lists required items with upload/acknowledge flows - Documentation (PRD + compliance checklist) published and linked to the sales enablement kit - Pricing A/B experiment ready to run with analytics hooks - Pilot cohort of 12 customers recruited and consented to data collection Stakeholders: Legal (Sara Cho), Security (Ravi Singh), Sales Ops (Janelle Ortiz), Engineering (James Park), Design (Maya Liu).
